messages:
nina: heads-up — CI failed during publish: typegen regen diffs from the new optional-fields patch. snapshot churn is blocking the SDK roll.

ryan: which package bump caused it?

nina: lockfile shows typegen 2.0.0 -> 2.1.0 in the SDK build. the patch introduced stable-sort for maps but tests assume old nondet order.

omar: we treated this as patch but it changes observable output. consumers (sample apps + older SDKs) rely on order. feels like minor.

ci-bot: pipeline #4880 failed: regendiff-check (https://ci.redwood/4880)

devx-bot: quick unblock: pin sdk-integration to typegen@2.0.0 in workspace to bypass regen checks.

ryan: agreed pin and follow-up remediation. options: revert to preserve patch semantics, or keep change and increment semver with migration notes.

nina: I've opened two PRs: revert in typegen and pin in sdk-integration. kicking CI.

ci-bot: pipeline #4881 started (after pin/revert).

ci-bot: pipeline #4881 passed — pinned manifest bypassed regendiff.

omar: action items: add a devex doc about "typegen output stability & semver rules", update release checklist to require changelog entry for any output-stability changes, and add a unit test asserting stable ordering when stable-sort is enabled.

ryan: also add guidance to sampleapp onboarding: pin devdeps to known-good typegen until we have a migration guide.

nina: thanks all — leaving notes here for traceability.
